Subject: Private CP access handoff: initial mapping and SCIM deltas

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Per our security checklist, we've exported our IdP metadata and a first-pass group-to-role mapping for Redwood's Private Control Plane. I'm attaching the IdP metadata (idp-metadata.xml) and a basic role mapping CSV.

Couple of clarifying items before we schedule the cutover:
- Does Redwood expect group membership to be pushed via SCIM or is it acceptable to rely on the SAML assertion only for role membership?
- For SAML assertion attributes, which claim name do you prefer for entitlements ("entitlement", "eduPersonEntitlement", or a custom claim)?
- Are there size/ paging expectations for SCIM deltas (we have a few large groups ~8k users)?

If possible, please share your SCIM schema expectations (attribute names/types) and a short checklist for a test cutover. We are targeting a pilot next Tuesday 2027-05-11.

Thanks — happy to hop on 30m if that's easier.

Tom Hargreaves
Identity & Security Program Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: idp-metadata.xml (xml), role-mapping-v2.csv (csv)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP access handoff: initial mapping and SCIM deltas

Tom —

Appreciate the export. Quick answers up front:
- Redwood supports both patterns, but for Private CP we recommend SCIM group sync for authoritative group membership and SAML for session assertions. SCIM reduces drift and makes audits easier.
- Preferred entitlement claim: we consume either "entitlement" or "eduPersonEntitlement", but our recommended pattern is a namespaced entitlement: "urn:redwood:entitlement:role" (see mapping template).
- SCIM paging: send deltas with a page size <= 2000 and include a "totalResults" and "startIndex". For >5k groups we advise incremental sync by timestamp.

I've attached our SCIM schema template (scim-schema-v2.xlsx) and a role-mapping example. Two asks before the pilot:
1) Confirm whether groups are mapped 1:1 to Redwood roles or whether you want composite roles (i.e., group A + group B => role C).
2) Share a test user that we can use for end-to-end verification (email + expected groups).

Proposed times for a 30m runbook run-through: Thu 5/6 11:00-11:30 PT or Mon 5/10 09:00-09:30 PT. Which works?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Product Security — Identity Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-schema-v2.xlsx, role-mapping-template.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@acme-corp.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP access handoff: initial mapping and SCIM deltas

Tom / Priya —

Couple of engineering notes to avoid surprises during the pilot:
- SCIM: Redwood's SCIM accepts PATCH (RFC 7644) with "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"]. We recommend incremental delta sync via "lastModified" timestamps. Page size 500-2000 is fine; avoid extremely large page sizes.
- Group -> role naming: include the environment prefix in group names (e.g., "acme-prod:redwood-admins") so we can auto-scope roles during Private CP tenant onboarding.
- SAML: use NameID format persistent; include an "urn:redwood:entitlement:role" attribute where values are prefixed with the account shortname (e.g., "acme:infra-admin"). Session duration: we honor assertion-level session timeouts but cap to 8 hours for interactive sessions.
- For AWS-like role mappings (if you're mapping to cloud provider roles), we'll need the role ARN in the entitlement attribute.

I'll attach a small checklist and a sample role-mapping CSV in the runbook folder.

-Markus
Engineering Manager, Identity
Redwood Inference

Attaching SSO test export (sso-test-results.pdf). Let's take the Thurs 5/6 11:00 PT slot if that still works for your side.

Tom
